title: Replication materials for: Fragmented Trust, Uneven Returns: A Mixed-Methods Analysis of Water Governance and Socio-Ecological System Performance in Gold-Mining Territories
description:
Analysis code (Python and R) and results (tables and figures) for the article Fragmented Trust, Uneven Returns: A Mixed-Methods Analysis of Water Governance and Socio-Ecological System Performance in Gold-Mining Territories, submitted to Resources Policy. The study combines CB-SEM, fsQCA, NCA and multilevel models on a household survey (N = 980) in 15 veredas of a gold-mining territory in Antioquia, Colombia.

The survey microdata and questionnaire are not included for confidentiality reasons; access may be requested from the corresponding author. The repository documents the structure of the analysis dataset (DATA_DICTIONARY.md) so that the pipeline can be run once access is granted.

Code: MIT License. Tables and figures: CC BY 4.0.
notes: Funded by Universidad de Medellín, Universidad EAFIT, Universidad Pontificia Bolivariana and B2Gold Corp. (Gramalote Colombia) through the G8 R+D+i 2023 call.
